definitions: To harm oneself in an attempt to harm another or to express anger.
To act in a way that is detrimental to oneself in order to cause minor inconvenience or annoyance to someone else.
examples: He cut off his nose to spite his face by quitting his job over a minor disagreement.
Don't spite your face by refusing to participate; you'll only hurt your own chances.
She refused the compromise, effectively spiting her own face in the long run.
synonyms: to cut off one's nose to spite one's face
to shoot oneself in the foot
